DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談に使う資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought documents for your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社から写真で届きました。ただ、下の部分が切れていて読めません。これで相談できるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の資料写真が切れて読めないため相談可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The company sent a photo, but the bottom is cut off and unreadable. I'd like to check whether I can consult you with this.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can consult using a company document photo with an unreadable, cropped section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の紙はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the original paper with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社にあります。担当者へ撮り直しを頼めますが、今日はすぐ返事が来るか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本が会社にあり撮り直しを頼めるが即時返信は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's at the company. I can ask the person in charge to retake the photo, but I don't know whether they'll reply promptly today.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the original is at the company and you can request a new photo but cannot be sure of an immediate reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、確認したい用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, please tell me what you want to clarify.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この資料を何の手続きに使うのか知りたいです。会社の説明には、持って相談するようにとしか書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の説明が足りず資料を使う手続き自体を知りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to know what procedure this document is for. The company's explanation only says to bring it and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the company's instructions are insufficient and you want to know what procedure the document is used for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読める部分から用件を確認し、必要な資料は担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll use the readable parts to clarify your purpose, and the person in charge will explain what documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。会社へ聞き直すために、足りない部分や必要な資料の名前をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社へ問い合わせるため不足部分と必要資料名を記録したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'd like to note the missing sections and names of the required documents so I can ask the company again.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to record the missing sections and required document names for an inquiry to your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内を聞きながらメモしていただけます。撮り直した写真が届いたらお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can take notes as you hear the explanation. If the new photo arrives, please show it to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず手元の写真で相談します。届くまで待つ必要があれば、予約の取り直しも担当の方に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現資料で相談し必要なら再予約を担当へ尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll first consult using the photo I have. If I need to wait for the new one, I'll also ask the person in charge about booking again.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will consult using the current material and ask the person in charge about rebooking if necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。写真と会社からの説明をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please show us the photo and the company's explanation.

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 座席についてご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your seats?

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私が四A、友人が四Bです。隣だと思いましたが、号車が違いました。一緒に座れるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ四A四Bでも号車違いで隣席か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm in four A and my friend is in four B. I thought we were next to each other, but the carriages are different. I'd like to check whether we can sit together.
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that seats four A and four B are in different carriages and check whether they are adjacent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの号車番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me each carriage number.

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は一号車、友人は二号車でした。日付と列車名は同じですが、離れてしまっています。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ列車の日付で一号車と二号車に分かれたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm in carriage one, and my friend is in carriage two. The date and train name are the same, but our seats are apart.
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are in carriages one and two on the same date and train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の指定のままでは、別々の車両のお席です。変更のご希望は、お二人とも同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: With your current reservations, the seats are in separate carriages. Do both of you want the same change?

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、二人とも隣の席を希望しています。空いている席へ変更できるか、手続きを教えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人合意で隣席への変更と手続きを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, we both want adjacent seats. Please tell us the procedure and whether we can change to available seats.
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you both agree on changing to adjacent seats and request the procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この列車の変更可否を確認します。できない場合はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check whether changes are possible for this train. What will you do if they aren't?

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 変更できなければ、今の席で乗ります。発車前には二人で会って、到着後の合流場所を決めます。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更不可なら現指定を使い到着後の合流場所を決めると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: If we can't change, we'll use our current seats. We'll meet before departure and decide where to meet again after arriving.
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the existing seats if a change is impossible and decide a meeting place after arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認のため、二枚の切符をお示しください。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show me both tickets so I can check.

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚ともこちらです。変更に費用が掛かる場合は、決める前に教えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚の切符を示し変更費用を判断前に知らせてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here are both. If there's a charge for changing, please tell us before we decide.
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show both tickets and ask to be told any change fee before deciding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二人分の変更について確認します。
DLG-SC-TCG-OYAMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check the change for both of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 苗の準備は終わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished preparing the seedlings?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本数はそろいましたが、並べ方を間違えたかもしれません。次の作業へ進む前に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本数は合うが並びを間違えた可能性を報告し確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The number is correct, but I may have arranged them incorrectly. Could you look before I move on to the next task?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the quantity is right but the arrangement may be wrong, and ask for a check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作業票とどこが違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: How does it differ from the work sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 票では端の四穴を空けることになっています。私は途中の四穴を空けてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指示の端四穴と実際の途中四穴の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The sheet says to leave the four holes at the edge empty. I left four holes in the middle empty instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the instructed four edge holes and the four middle holes you left empty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の状態を確認します。そのトレーはほかの物と一緒にしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the current condition. Have you put that tray together with the others?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ分けて置いています。隣のトレーは別の人が準備したので、そちらは触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象トレーを分け他人のトレーには触っていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's still set apart. Someone else prepared the neighboring tray, so I haven't touched that one.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you kept the affected tray separate and have not touched someone else's tray. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままにしておいてください。移し替えができるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave it as it is. I'll check whether the seedlings can be moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。急いで自分で直そうと思いましたが、苗を傷めたくないので指示を待ちます。作業票も一緒に置いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己判断で移さず苗を傷めないため指示を待ち票を添えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I was going to hurry and fix it myself, but I don't want to damage the seedlings, so I'll wait for instructions. I'll leave the work sheet with it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not move them on your own, will wait for instructions to avoid damage, and will leave the work sheet with them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が来るまで、次のトレーの確認をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until the person in charge arrives, could you check the next tray?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。間違えたトレーはここに残して、次は並べる前に空ける位置を票と照合します。担当が来たら私から説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象を残し次は並べる前に票を照合し担当へ自分で説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll leave the incorrect tray here. For the next one, I'll check the empty positions against the sheet before arranging the seedlings. I'll explain it myself when the person in charge arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the affected tray, check the sheet before the next arrangement, and say you will explain directly to the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。こちらのトレーは担当に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. We'll have the person in charge check this tray.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのようなお料理に使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: What will you be cooking today?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同僚と四人で夕食を作ります。フライパンで焼く予定ですが、どの肉が扱いやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数とフライパンでの調理予定を伝え肉を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are four of us making dinner with coworkers. We plan to pan-fry it. Which meat would be easy to work with?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the number of people and your plan to cook in a frying pan, and ask about meat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの豚肉はいかがですか。厚さは皆さん同じでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: How about this pork? Would everyone like the same thickness?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人は薄い肉が好きです。残りの二人は少し厚いものを希望しているので、分けて買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人ずつ厚さの好みが違うため別々に買えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two prefer thin meat. The other two would like it a little thicker. Can we buy those separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that two people prefer each thickness and ask to buy them separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二種類に分けられます。味付けは済んでいるものをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can split it into two types. Would you like meat that's already seasoned?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分たちで味付けします。味の付いていないものを、それぞれ二人分お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 味付け前の肉を二種類それぞれ二人分頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll season it ourselves. Two people's portions of each type, unseasoned, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order two people's portions each of two types of unseasoned meat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの量でいかがですか。ほかのおかずもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: How is this quantity? Will you have other dishes too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 野菜とご飯も用意します。この量でお願いします。薄い方と厚い方が分かるように包んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ほかのおかずを伝え量を決め包装を区別してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll prepare vegetables and rice too. This quantity is fine. Could you package them so we can tell the thin and thick meat apart?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the other dishes, decide the quantity, and ask for distinguishable packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分けてお包みします。この後はすぐお帰りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll package them separately. Are you going straight home after this?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ買い物があるので、肉は最後に受け取りたいです。先に会計して、戻るまで預かっていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 買い物後に受け取れるか会計と一時預かりを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I still have shopping to do, so I'd like to collect the meat last. Could I pay first and have you keep it until I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about paying and temporary storage so you can collect the meat after shopping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりできるか確認しますので、少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check whether we can hold it, so please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込みのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手の資料には本店とあります。私が今いる支店の名前を書けばよいと思いましたが、振込先の欄を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今いる支店名を振込先へ書いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient's document says ‘head office.’ I thought I should write the name of the branch I'm at now, but I'd like to check the destination field.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to write your current branch's name in the transfer destination field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取人からの資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the document from the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。相手の銀行名と本店という支店名が書いてあります。どの欄へ書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取人の銀行支店資料を示し記入欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here it is. It has their bank name and ‘head office’ as the branch name. Which fields should I write them in?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the recipient's bank and branch information and ask which fields to complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 振込先は、受取人が指定した情報として確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the transfer destination as the information specified by the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この銀行名と支店名ですね。書き写したら、資料と合っているか見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀行支店を書き写した後に資料との照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This bank name and branch name, then. After I copy them, could you check that they match the document?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to compare the copied bank and branch names with the document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 口座の名義も、ご確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you also confirm the account holder's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名義もありますが、読み方が分からない所があります。相手へ聞いてから記入したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名義の読み方が不明な部分を相手へ確認してから記入したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The name is there too, but there's a part I don't know how to read. I'd like to ask the recipient before entering it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to confirm the unclear reading of part of the account name with the recipient before entering it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が済んでから、依頼内容をお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show us your transfer request after you've confirmed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は名義の確認ができるまで提出を待ちます。確認して戻る場合、記入中の用紙を持って帰ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出を待ち確認のため用紙を持ち帰れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait to submit it until I can confirm the name. If I'm going to check and return, may I take the partly completed form home?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Postpone submission and ask whether you may take the form home while checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙の扱いは担当に確認します。受取人の情報がそろってからご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check with the person in charge how to handle the form. Please consult us once you have all the recipient's information.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はお仕事のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here for work advice today?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、私の相談で来ました。家族が付き添っていますが、家族も自分の仕事について質問したいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の相談に同行した家族も自身の仕事を質問したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, for my own consultation. My family member is accompanying me, but they say they'd like to ask about their own work too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the family member accompanying your consultation also wants to ask about their own work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の相談と、家族の方の相談を別々に伺う必要があるか確認します。家族の方はここにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check whether we need to hear your consultation and your family member's separately. Are they here?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口で待っています。私の通訳だけのつもりでしたが、途中で家族自身も相談したいと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の場所と通訳のみの予定から用件が変わったことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're waiting at the entrance. They originally intended only to interpret for me, but on the way we realized they wanted their own consultation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where your family member is and that the plan changed from interpreting only to having their own inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、それぞれの希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, we'll ask what each of you wants.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は求人の内容を確認したいです。家族の希望は本人から話してもらいたいので、呼んできていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の希望を述べ家族には本人から話してもらうため呼ぶ許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to clarify the details of a job opening. I'd like my family member to explain their own request, so may I go and get them?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your own request and ask permission to call your family member so they can speak for themselves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。二人でお戻りになったら受付の案内をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. When you both return, we'll guide you through reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族を呼んできました。先に私の用紙へ二人分を書いてしまいましたが、書き直した方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族を連れて戻り用紙へ二人分を書いた誤記の直し方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've brought them over. I already wrote information for both of us on my form. Should I rewrite it?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Return with your family member and ask how to correct the form on which you entered both people's information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入した内容を拝見します。直す箇所をご案内しますので、まだ提出しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let me see what you've written. We'll explain which parts to correct, so please don't submit it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。用紙をお見せします。相談の順番は、案内を聞いてから家族と決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未提出の用紙を示し案内後に家族と相談順を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll show you the form. After hearing the guidance, I'll decide the order of our consultations with my family member.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the unsubmitted form and say you will decide the consultation order with your family member after hearing the guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お二人の用件を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's check both of your requests.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面について何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が先に投げましたが、画面では私の名前が一番上です。結果が私の所へ付いたようなので、直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初投球の結果が違う名前に付いたと知らせ修正を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend bowled first, but my name is at the top of the screen. The result seems to have been added under my name. Can it be corrected?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the first throw's result was added under the wrong name and ask about correcting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は何人で遊んでいますか。何回投げましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: How many people are playing now, and how many throws have you made?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人です。友人が一回だけ投げて、そこで気づいて止めました。私はまだ投げていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人で友人のみ一投し自分は未投球と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two of us. My friend threw just once, and we noticed and stopped there. I haven't thrown yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there are two players, your friend has made one throw, and you have not thrown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 画面を確認します。次の投球は少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the screen. Please wait before the next throw.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。友人にも待つよう伝えます。名前を入れるとき、私が先に登録したのが原因かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再開を待ち友人へも伝え自分が先に登録したことを話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll tell my friend to wait too. It may be because I registered my name first when entering the names.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait to resume, tell your friend too, and explain that you registered yourself first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 登録順と投球順を確認します。今後はどちらを先にしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the registration and throwing orders. Who would you like to go first from now on?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人を先にしたいです。順番を変えられるなら、名前も本人が分かる短い呼び方にしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人を先にし短い表示名への変更も希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like my friend to go first. If you can change the order, could you also make the displayed names short forms that each of us recognizes?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for your friend to go first and for shorter display names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更できる範囲を確認します。直した画面で順番を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check what can be changed. Please confirm the order on the corrected screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二人で画面を見てから再開します。最初の一投がどう扱われるかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人で画面を確認して再開し初投球の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We'll both look at the screen before resuming. Please also tell us how the first throw will be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will both check the screen before resuming and ask how the initial throw will be handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。名前の順と最初の投球を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll check the name order and the first throw.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your medicine?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝、薬を飲んだか思い出せません。次にどうすればいいか、薬剤師さんに相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今朝服用したか覚えていないため薬剤師への相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't remember whether I took my medicine this morning. I'd like to ask the pharmacist what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to consult a pharmacist because you cannot remember whether you took your morning medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お薬の名前が分かるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have anything showing the medicine's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この袋です。普段はケースに入れますが、今週はまだ入れていないので、空の枠では確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薬袋を示しケースは未準備で空欄を確認に使えないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This bag. I normally put it in a pill organizer, but I haven't prepared it for this week yet, so the empty compartments can't tell me.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the medicine bag and explain that the unprepared organizer's empty compartments cannot confirm whether you took it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬剤師におつなぎします。覚えていることを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll connect you with the pharmacist. Please tell me what you remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 朝食の後に水を飲んだことは覚えています。薬の袋を開けたかは自信がありません。服用のメモも今日は空欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝食後の水は覚えているが薬袋を開けたか不確かで服用記録もないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I remember drinking water after breakfast. I'm not sure whether I opened the medicine bag. Today's medication note is blank too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you remember water after breakfast but are unsure whether you opened the medicine bag and have no medication record today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋とメモをお持ちになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait with the bag and your notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族が家にいるので、机に薬を出したままにしていないか聞いてみます。返事が来たら見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ机上の薬を確認してもらい返事を示すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. My family is at home, so I'll ask whether I left the medicine out on the desk. I'll show you their reply when it arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask family to check the desk for medicine and show their reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに飲んでいる薬があれば、一緒にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you're taking other medicine, please mention that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: もう一種類あります。写真をスマホに入れているので、それも薬剤師さんに見せます。今日の分をどうするか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別の薬の写真も示し今日の扱いを薬剤師へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: There's one other type. I have a photo on my phone, so I'll show that to the pharmacist too. Please tell me what to do about today's dose.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show a photo of your other medicine too and ask the pharmacist what to do about today's dose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。分かる情報をそろえて薬剤師にご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Gather the information you know and explain it to the pharmacist.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持戻とあるので、もう送り主へ返したのかと思いました。今の状態を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持戻を差出人返送済みと思い現在状態を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says ‘brought back,’ so I thought it had already been returned to the sender. I'd like to check its current status.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought ‘brought back’ meant already returned to the sender and ask for the current status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この表示だけで差出人への返送済みとは読まないでください。票の番号で現在の扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't read this status alone as meaning it's been returned to the sender. We'll use the notice number to check how it's currently being handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。不在だった日の票が残っています。送り主に連絡する前に、ここで状況を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不在票番号を示し送り主への連絡前に状況を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the number. I've kept the notice from the day I was out. I'd like to hear the situation here before contacting the sender.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the notice number and say you want to know the situation before contacting the sender. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お受取りのご希望を伺います。今、再配達を頼んだ記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask how you would like to receive it. Do you currently have a record of a redelivery request?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ再配達は頼んでいません。家族と受け取れる時間を相談してから、依頼したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再配達は未依頼で家族と受取時刻を相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't requested redelivery yet. I'd like to discuss when someone can receive it with my family before requesting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say redelivery has not been requested and you will discuss a receiving time with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取り方は、現在の保管状態を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain collection options after checking its current storage status.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。家に届くなら土曜の午前が希望です。難しい場合は別の受け取り方も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 土曜午前の希望を伝え難しい場合の別受取方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. If it can come to my home, I'd prefer Saturday morning. If that's difficult, please tell me another way to receive it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your Saturday-morning preference and ask for alternatives if that is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認に使う票は、そのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the notice we use for checking as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 票を残しておきます。家族には確認中と伝えますので、今の保管場所と選べる受取方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 票を保持して家族へ確認中と知らせ保管場所と受取方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep it. I'll tell my family it's being checked, so please tell me where it's currently stored and which receiving options are available.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the notice, tell your family it is being checked, and ask about storage location and receiving methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号で現在の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-OYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check the current status using the number.

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このロットは直径を測って記録します。開始前に、測定器の点検欄を見てください。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-01.translation: We'll measure and record the diameter for this lot. Before starting, look at the measuring instrument's inspection field.

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日の点検欄が空白です。前の人が記入し忘れたのか、点検していないのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当日の点検欄が空白で実施の有無も分からないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-02.translation: Today's inspection field is blank. I don't know whether the previous person forgot to write it down or didn't inspect it.
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that today's inspection field is blank and you do not know whether the inspection occurred. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分からないまま使うのはやめましょう。私から責任者に確認します。その器具で、もう製品を測りましたか。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's not use it while that's unclear. I'll check with the supervisor. Have you measured any products with it yet?

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ測っていません。箱も開けていないので、このロットは未検査のままです。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ測定も開封もしておらずロットは未検査だと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I haven't opened the box either, so this lot is still uninspected.
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have neither measured nor opened the box and the lot remains uninspected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では未検査の札をそのまま残します。隣の測定器は点検済みですが、番号が違うので記録票との対応を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we'll leave the uninspected tag on. The instrument beside it has been inspected, but its number is different, so let's check its correspondence with the record sheet.

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 代わりの器具を使うなら、記録票の測定器番号も変更する必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の測定器を使うとき記録票の器具番号を変更するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-06.translation: If we use a replacement instrument, do we also need to change the instrument number on the record sheet?
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to change the instrument number on the record when using a different measuring instrument. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、実際に使う番号を記録します。変更方法はこの記入例です。測る位置は図の矢印で示した部分ですが、見えますか。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, record the number actually used. This example shows how to change it. The measuring position is indicated by the arrow in the diagram. Can you see it?

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 矢印が二本あって迷います。外側の直径を測るのか、内側を測るのか、実物で示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二本の矢印で迷うため外径か内径か実物で示してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are two arrows, so I'm unsure. Could you show me on the actual item whether we're measuring the outer or inner diameter?
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a demonstration on the actual item of whether to measure the outer or inner diameter because the two arrows are confusing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回測るのは外側です。この位置を見てください。最初の一個は一緒に測り、記録の内容まで照合します。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-09.translation: This time we're measuring the outside. Look at this position. We'll measure the first one together and compare the recorded details too.

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 点検済みの器具番号を記録し、外側を測ります。最初の一個は、数値を書いた後で見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 点検済みの器具番号を記録して外径を測り、最初の一個の数値を確認してもらうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll record the inspected instrument's number and measure the outside. For the first item, I'll ask you to check after I write the reading.
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record the inspected instrument number, measure the outer diameter, and have the first item's reading checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その手順で始めましょう。空欄だった器具は確認が済むまで使いません。ここまでの確認、お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-TKS-ANAN-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's start with that procedure. We won't use the instrument with the blank field until it has been checked. Thank you for checking everything so far.
